newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Delloyd debuts at 8.00 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Delloyd debuts at 8.00 ringgit.

text.p: Auto parts maker Delloyd Ventures Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Monday at 8.00 ringgit, compared with a 4.00 ringgit offer price.
At 0135 GMT, the stock was trading at 8.80 ringgit after more than 800,000 shares changed hands.
The company, which listed on the Main Board, offered 8.1 million shares to the public.
Delloyd's clients include national car maker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) and distributor Edaran Otomobil Nasional Bhd, which together account for 66 percent of the group's turnover.
For the year ending December 31, 1996, the company has estimated a pre-tax profit of 29.27 million ringgit, against 27.35 million in 1995.
In a report issued on Friday, HLG Securities said that it sees as positive Delloyd's entry into foreign markets to broaden its client base.
The expansion overseas should position the company to take advantage of a lucrative Southeast Asian car market, it said.
HLG Securities said the stock should be fairly valued at 6.50 ringgit.
